decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several portable options focused on value and reliability. My consideration set included the ultra-popular EWA mini speaker, a renewed JBL Flip 5 for professional-grade sound, and several rugged, waterproof speakers from comiso and XENEO. The JBL Flip 5 was the strongest on audio performance, but as a renewed item, it had some mixed reviews regarding battery longevity. The comiso 173 offered great wattage (30W) and a flashlight, but the EWA A106 Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) stood out as the most compelling purchase. Its massive review volume (over 39,000) combined with a high rating and an extremely low price of $17.99 makes it an unbeatable value for a secondary, travel-friendly speaker.
